title: request_approval
description: Ask a person to approve or look. It only creates a request in the log; it never approves anything. A person answers in a terminal or with a signed token.

target.description: What to approve: a change ID, a feature ID, project, roadmap, or an outcome/experiment ID.

note.description: What the person should look at.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.
